result.summary: Identified 1 major visual defect in the bottom navigation bar where an incorrect icon is rendered.

issues.description: The 'Search' icon in the bottom navigation bar is visually broken. It appears as a grey circular shape with a thick horizontal line extending to the right, resembling a slider control, rather than a standard magnifying glass icon. It also lacks the consistent outline style of the other icons in the navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Replace the incorrect asset with a proper search (magnifying glass) icon that matches the visual style and weight of the 'Home', 'Orders', and 'Profile' icons.
